purpose: Canonical machine-readable documentation standing ladder for source recovery, claim management, drift detection and standing-aware retrieval across O:I Projects.

standings.label: authored position
standings.question: What meaning or determination does a recognised author remain responsible for at this scope?

standings.label: design commitment
standings.question: What deliberately adopted design determination is intended to realise the authored position?

standings.label: architecture contract
standings.question: What structural relation, interface, invariant or ownership boundary is implementation expected to satisfy?
established_by: owner-recognised protocol, schema, interface or architecture relation
does_not_establish: current implementation merely because a diagram describes it

standings.label: implementation fact
standings.question: What does the current source or executable implementation actually contain or do at this revision?

standings.label: observed evidence
standings.question: What actually happened in an identifiable Run, test, CI job, measurement, deployment or human observation?
established_by: Run, test, CI, benchmark, acceptance or experience receipt
does_not_establish: general implementation fact outside the observed condition

standings.label: Agent inference
standings.question: What interpretation, synthesis, diagnosis, hypothesis or proposal is derived from other sources?
established_by: explicitly attributable Agent or generated synthesis

temporal_development_state: open, draft, blocked, merged, superseded or closed

management_rules: Recover relevant native sources before assigning or relying on standing.
Treat filenames and extensions as discovery hints only.
Preserve provenance, scope and exact revision alongside standing.
Classify materially different claims independently when one file contains more than one standing.
Surface conflicts between adjacent standings as drift rather than resolving them with a scalar highest-wins rule.
Do not silently promote Agent inference into observed evidence, implementation fact, architecture contract, design commitment or authored position.
Do not silently promote observed evidence into implementation fact or implementation fact into architecture/design/authorship.
Keep current development state as temporal/lifecycle context rather than a documentation standing.
Attach P0-P5 only as situated Project-act participation; never use P1 World as a catch-all documentation standing.
Retain heterogeneous native Project sources in place when stable refs and relations are sufficient.
